abstract: This trial was a single-arm, open-label design to evaluate the efficacy and safety of "TQB2916+ gemcitabine + albumin-paclitaxel" as the first-line treatment for metastatic pancreatic cancer.

source.journal: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Nanjing Shunxin Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
source.name: ClinicalTrials.gov

title: A Clinical Study on the First-line Treatment of Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer With TQB2916 Injection Combined With Gemcitabine Hydrochloride for Injection and Paclitaxel for Injection (Albumin-bound Type)

trial.sponsor: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Nanjing Shunxin Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
